title: Salesforce unavailable during case creation
description: Every Salesforce call fails (connection refused) for the duration of the call.
callerVisible: Caller receives a support reference described as pending synchronization, never an invented Salesforce Case number.
backendEvidence: Encrypted internal support request persisted with reference
Reconciliation queued (outbox / DLQ visible to operators)
notes: INFORMATION_PROVIDED is acceptable only for reads served by the internal support record (case follow-up: resolution contract source system support_records), which do not depend on Salesforce; intake flows still expect REQUEST_ACCEPTED in their own scenario expectations. Version 2 added it (the case-read variants previously could only fail this check).

registry.injectionPoint: the Salesforce emulator refuses connections for the whole call

postconditions: An encrypted internal support request with a reference is persisted while Salesforce refuses connections
Synchronization is queued (outbox / DLQ visible to operators); no invented Case number is spoken
The request has an audit event
